name: 양자화 매개변수 분석
description: Analyzes video codec QP values for compression consistency — re-encoded deepfakes show QP anomalies.
mechanism:
This method analyzes quantization parameter (QP) patterns for video forensic detection:

1. **QPMap추출**: The per-macroblock quantization parameter is extracted from the video bitstream. The QP map reveals how the encoder allocated quality across the frame — lower QP (higher quality) for important/complex regions, higher QP (lower quality) for simpler regions.

2. **QP분포분석**: The QP distribution across the frame is analyzed. Authentic single-encoded video shows QP values following the encoder's rate-control algorithm — smooth QP variation correlated with content complexity. Re-encoded video (manipulation + re-encoding) shows QP distributions influenced by two encoding passes.

3. **QP-Content일관성**: The relationship between QP and local content complexity is verified. In normal encoding, complex regions (edges, texture) receive lower QP. Manipulated regions may show QP-content mismatches — the second encoder's QP decisions may not optimally match the inserted content.

4. **DoubleQuantization감지**: When video is decoded, manipulated, and re-encoded, characteristic double-quantization artifacts appear in the QP and DCT coefficient distributions. The method detects periodicities in DCT histograms that indicate the original QP, revealing the encoding history.

5. **시간적QP패턴분석**: QP allocation across frames follows the encoder's rate control model — I-frames typically get lower QP than P/B-frames. The method analyzes temporal QP patterns for anomalies. Manipulated video segments may show QP pattern breaks where the manipulation disrupted the original rate control.
parameters: 분석 유형: 자동 통계\n점수 범위: 0(실제)~100(AI 생성)
source: 디지털 포렌식 및 AI 콘텐츠 탐지 관련 동료 검토 연구 기반.
useCase: AI 생성 콘텐츠를 탐지하기 위한 다중 신호 분석 파이프라인의 일부로 사용.
strengths: • 연구 기반 방법론\n• 빠른 계산 속도\n• 다른 탐지 방법과 보완적
limitations: • 정확도는 입력 품질에 따라 변동\n• 다른 방법과 함께 사용하는 것이 최적
